_draftMarkersNote: true shows a small Draft, pending Herman pill on the testimony consent, the Walk with me invite, prices, and the prayers. Set to false at go-live; no content edits needed.
_formsModeNote: live posts to Netlify Forms at '/'. stub keeps submissions in the outbox and never sends (used for local tests).
_newWordingDraftNote: steps-next preview: true shows Draft, pending Herman pills on new wording in the app and on /groups/. Must be false to ship.
_groupWalksNote: steps-groups preview only: true shows Group walks (needs the fim.groups tables, which exist only on the Neon preview branch). check.mjs fails if true on steps-prod-golive.
_draftOnlyNote: When set, only these new pieces of wording carry the Draft, pending Herman pill (everything else is already approved).
